body:
Worldwide

We’re thrilled to announce that registration for the SPE Java Section Scholarship Program 2025 is now open! 🌟 This scholarship is dedicated to supporting the growth and potential of our student members in the petroleum engineering field.

🗓 Registration Period: 8 Nov – 22 Nov 2024
📍 Eligibility: Open to all active SPE Java student members
🔗 Register through: https://forms.gle/KBVkq8czpuxSZTxt7

Don't miss this chance to invest in your future and boost your career in energy! Apply now and take the next step toward your dreams. 💼✨
